definitions.gloss: youthful; looking young; full of youthful energy
definitions.explanation: Appearing or feeling young, especially for one's age. A compliment suggesting vitality, freshness, and energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{若々|わかわか}しい。
{若々|わかわか}しい⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
60⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{若々|わかわか}しくて、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Even past 60, they look so youthful that you'd never guess their age.

notes: Formed by doubling {若|わか}い (young) with the suffix ⟦しい→する：00392_suru⟧, creating an emphatic, vivid adjective. Used as a compliment, especially for older people who look or act younger than their age. Common collocations: {若々|わかわか}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (youthful appearance), {若々|わかわか}しい⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (youthful voice). Unlike {若|わか}い, which simply states that someone is young, {若々|わかわか}しい emphasizes the impression of youthfulness.
